title: Apartment 52, Hillcourt, Rathgar, Dublin 6, D06YK74
description:
Herbert & Lansdowne are delighted to present Apartment 52 Hillcourt, Highfield Road, Rathgar to the market. Ideally positioned in a quiet and well-established development, this attractive two-bedroom apartment offers an excellent opportunity for buyers seeking a property in one of Dublin 6’s most sought-after residential locations.
Extending to approximately 62 sq. m. (667 sq. ft.), the property is well proportioned throughout and benefits from a C-rated BER. While the apartment would benefit from some modernisation and upgrading, it offers an excellent blank canvas for a new owner to create a stylish and contemporary home to their own taste.
The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a bright living/dining room, separate kitchen, two well-proportioned bedrooms and a main bathroom. The apartment is situated within a quiet block, providing a peaceful residential setting while remaining exceptionally well connected to the city and surrounding suburbs.
The location is a particular highlight. Rathgar is renowned for its mature tree-lined streets, village atmosphere and excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, shops and local amenities. The property is also within easy reach of Rathmines, Terenure and Ranelagh, while Dublin city centre is readily accessible by a number of public transport options.
This property is likely to appeal to first-time buyers, downsizers, investors and those looking to put their own stamp on a property in a highly desirable Dublin 6 location.

Accommodation: Approx. 62 sq. m. / 667 sq. ft.
Condition: Requires some modernisation and upgrading
Location: Quiet, established residential development
Service charge €2290 p/a
